page.overview:
Who is Dycedarg Beoulve?

Count Dycedarg Beoulve}} is a character in Final Fantasy Tactics. The eldest brother of main protagonist Ramza Beoulve, Dycedarg served under Duke Bestrald Larg for the Order of the Northern Sky during the War of the Lions. He sought to elevate House Beoulve no matter the cost to enrich himself and gain power.

Dycedarg was a skilled military tactician who became Duke Larg's strategist, after ceding the position of Order of the Northern Sky to his brother, Zalbaag Beoulve, at the request of his late father, Barbaneth Beoulve.

Dycedarg's job is the rune knight, wielding both powerful magick and devastating sword techniques.

Dycedarg was the firstborn son of war hero Barbaneth Beoulve and a childhood friend of Duke Larg. The role he played in the Fifty Years' War is unclear, but his relaying a message from Advocate Lenarrio of Ordallia's envoy suggests he may have been involved in diplomatic relations.
